First, subtract 11 months from 1052-02-27:  
1052-02-27 → 1051-03-27 (since 11 months back from February goes to March of previous year).  

Then subtract 27 days from 1051-03-27:  
1051-03-27 minus 27 days → 1051-02-28 (March has 31 days, so 27 days back from March 27 = February 28 in a non-leap year 1051).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1051-02-28
